'''Bogga's enforcer gang''' was a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], thugs, and [[Gangster/Legends|gangsters]] led by Great [[Bogga]], a notorious [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]. Bogga's enforcers included many species one would usually find under the payroll of Hutts: [[Weequay/Legends|Weequays]], [[Nikto/Legends|Niktos]], [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fans]], and [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tibs]] were a few. Although their exact number is unknown, the enforcers of Great Bogga's that ''are'' known were [[Dreebo]], [[Gudb]], [[Quanto]], [[Rek (enforcer)|Rek]], [[Grimorg]], and [[Fnnbu]].

==History==
In [[3999 BBY]],<ref name="Chronology" /> Bogga and his enforcers were known to regularly frequent the [[Stenness Hyperspace Terminal]], a [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Space station/Legends|station]] located within the [[Stenness Node]]. It was here that they encountered the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Andur Sunrider]], who was traveling with his wife [[Nomi Sunrider|Nomi]] and their child [[Vima Sunrider]]. The enforcers overheard a conversation between Ander and his wife, whereupon they discovered that the travelers were in possession of a cache of precious [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystals]]. Gudb, the most senior of the enforcers, immediately reported this to his Hutt master. Following instruction directly from Great Bogga, the enforcers were ordered to recover the crystals by any means necessary.

Gudb and his gang accosted the Jedi family in the Stenness Hyperspace Terminal, where his pet [[Gorm-worm/Legends|gorm-worm]] attacked Andur Sunrider and killed him. In retaliation, Andur's wife Nomi picked up her dead husband's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the enforcer [[Quanto]], [[Sai tok/Legends|slicing him in half]] from shoulder to hip. The remaining enforcers returned to Bogga empty handed.

Several months later, Bogga sent his enforcers again to attack Andur's wife, who by this time had been [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on the nearby [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]]. They were unprepared for the strength of Nomi Sunrider and her [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Thon]], who soundly defeated them again, this time killing several more of the enforcers and sending them in shame back to their Hutt master. The activities of Great Bogga's Enforcer gang from that point on are unknown.
